description: You woke on the bunds between drowned paddies, the old terraces still holding their rectangles of sky. Feral rice nods in the standing water; egrets work the shallows. Food grows here if you learn the water — and the water takes back what it wants.
hazard: Monsoon floods drown the low paddies. Store food high and never sleep in the lowest field.
name: Fallow Paddies
tagline: Drowned terraces, feral rice, patient water

description: You woke under a ceiling of mango leaves, the old orchard gone wild around a ruined farmhouse. Fallen fruit perfumes the air and draws everything hungry for a mile — boars at night, monkeys by day, and you in between.
hazard: Falling fruit draws boars in season — and tigers follow the boars. Guard the harvest and the camp.
name: Old Mango Grove
tagline: A ruined orchard, generous and watched

description: You woke on worn stone steps running down to a wide brown river. The ghat is old — older than the Burn — and the river doesn't care; it rises in the wet season and takes the lower steps without asking. Boats rotted at their moorings years ago; the fish stayed.
hazard: The river rises fast in the wet season; the lower ghat steps go under. Never store anything below the high-water mark.
name: River Ghat
tagline: Old stone steps, a brown river, fish
